{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment turns negative, forecast prices must be below both recent mean and 30-day lag more than 2 CERs to avoid lagging behind rapid price drops",
    "Model-forecasted prices must never be above the highest price in the last 7-day history when sentiment is positive (sentiment-driven demand support creates hard price floors)",
    "When sentiment is strongly negative (-0.67 to -1.00), forecast prices must be at least 1.5 CERs below current price to capture expected rapid mean reversion to support levels",
    "Avoid overshooting current price by more than 2 CERs when sentiment is neutral (|sentiment| < 0.33) as momentum is too weak to justify the forecast magnitude",
    "When sentiment has been fluctuating without trend over the last 6+ sentiment readings, forecast prices must cluster within 2 CERs of the 7-day price lag to eliminate false momentum signals",
    "Do not project sentiment-driven price movements more than 5 days into the forecast horizon when sentiment magnitude is weak (|sentiment| < 0.50), as these effects decay quickly",
    "When true outcomes show continuous price decline over any 10-day window within the 30-day forecast, the forecast must be at least 2 CERs below the linear decline baseline at corresponding horizons" ]}
